'''Tawss Khaa''' was a [[Nimbanel]] with [[Color|reddish-brown]] [[hair]], fair skin and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="Objets" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1|Tawss Khaa's appearance}}</ref> Khaa was seated in a booth behind<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> the [[Qiraash]] [[Leesub Sirln]]<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 3|cardname=Leesub Sirln}}</ref> and the [[Lutrillian]] [[Ownellco]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]]<ref name="Objets" /> [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="ANH" />

The Nimbanel took a sip from a glass as the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] entered with the [[droid]]s [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]]. Khaa was later walking through the streets of Mos Eisley past the entrance to [[Docking Bay 94]] when Skywalker and the droids were entering the docking bay with the [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]]. Khaa wore a red [[Clothing|uniform]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tawss Khaa was portrayed by [[Eileen Roberts]]<ref name="MCM">{{WebCite|url=https://www.londoncomicconspring.com/guest/eileen-roberts|text=Eileen Roberts|work=[[Wikipedia:MCM Comic Con London|MCM Comic Con London]]|archivedate=20240218231546}}</ref> in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The character's mask was made by creature designer [[Stuart Freeborn]]. In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first named in the [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars, Objets du mythe]]'', which was written by [[Patrice Girod]] and [[Arnaud Grunberg]].<ref name="Objets" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the name originated on a card in the [[1998]] ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' set for ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''. published by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Tawss Khaa}}</ref>
